# Intuition Docs (V1)

Version: V1
Scope: V1 covers the `intuition-ts` packages and `intuition-rs` services.
Other versions: V2 — https://docs.intuition.systems/llms.txt

> Intuition is a permissionless protocol for creating verifiable, tokenized attestations on a Layer 3 blockchain. Developers build context-aware applications using semantic triples (subject-predicate-object relationships) backed by economic incentives through bonding curves. The three core primitives are Atoms (universal identifiers), Triples (structured claims), and Signals (staked conviction).

- [llms-full.txt](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/llms-full.txt): Complete documentation with full page content for deep reference
- [llms-medium.txt](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/llms-medium.txt): Condensed summaries with metadata — fits in a single context window

## Quick Start

- [Choose Your Path](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/getting-started/choose-your-path.md): Decision tree — routes to SDK, GraphQL, Protocol, or concepts based on your goal
- [SDK Quick Start](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/quick-start/using-the-sdk.md): Install the SDK, create atoms and triples, run your first example
- [Network Details](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/quick-start/network-details.md): Chain IDs, RPC endpoints, and block explorers for mainnet and testnet
- [Contract Deployments](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/quick-start/deployments.md): All contract addresses for mainnet and testnet
- [Testnet Faucet](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/quick-start/testnet-faucet.md): Get test tokens for development

## Core Concepts

- [Overview](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/getting-started/overview.md): What Intuition is — Network, Protocol, and Subnet layers explained
- [Architecture](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/getting-started/architecture.md): Full system architecture — L3 chain, EthMultiVault, event pipeline, indexing, and caching
- [Primitives Overview](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/intuition-concepts/primitives.md): How Atoms, Triples, and Signals work together as a data model
- [Atoms](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/intuition-concepts/primitives/Atoms/fundamentals.md): Universal identifiers for entities, concepts, and data — the nodes in the knowledge graph
- [Triples](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/intuition-concepts/primitives/Triples/fundamentals.md): Subject-predicate-object claims — the edges in the knowledge graph
- [Signals](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/intuition-concepts/primitives/Signals/fundamentals.md): Staked conviction on atoms and triples — the weights in the knowledge graph

## Economics

- [Bonding Curves](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/intuition-concepts/economics/bonding-curves.md): How dynamic pricing works for atom and triple vaults
- [Fees & Rewards](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/intuition-concepts/economics/fees-and-rewards.md): Protocol fee structure, reward distribution, and staking incentives

## Developer Tools

Use the SDK for frontend/full-stack apps, GraphQL for read-heavy queries, Protocol package for direct contract interaction, and the Interaction Guide for low-level call patterns.

- [SDK Overview](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/intuition-sdk/quick-start.md): TypeScript/JavaScript SDK — atoms, triples, signals, vaults, search, and batch operations
- [GraphQL API](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/graphql-api/overview.md): Query the knowledge graph — atoms, triples, vaults, positions, activity, and subscriptions
- [Smart Contracts](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/intuition-smart-contracts.md): Contract architecture — MultiVault, Trust Token, Trust Bonding, and bonding curves
- [Contract Interactions](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/interaction-guide/overview.md): Low-level patterns for creating atoms/triples, depositing, and reading vault state
- [Protocol Package](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/protocol/getting-started/overview.md): Direct protocol interaction via TypeScript — configuration, vaults, epochs, and events

## Tutorials

- [Tutorials Overview](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/tutorials/overview.md): Index of all step-by-step building guides
- [Reputation System](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/tutorials/reputation-system.md): Build skill attestations, endorsements, and reputation scoring
- [Curated Lists](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/tutorials/curated-lists.md): Token-curated registries with stake-based community ranking
- [Social Attestations](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/tutorials/social-attestations.md): Decentralized identity with portable connections and recommendations
- [Fraud Detection](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/tutorials/fraud-detection.md): Community-driven scam flagging with expert-weighted voting
- [Prediction Market](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/tutorials/prediction-market.md): Non-resolving forecasting with track records and confidence signals
- [Activity Feeds](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/tutorials/queries/building-user-activity-feeds.md): Build personalized activity streams with GraphQL
- [Related Claims](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/tutorials/queries/finding-related-claims.md): Discover relationship patterns in the knowledge graph
- [Top dApps Query](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/tutorials/queries/finding-top-dapps-on-coinbase.md): Rank decentralized applications by market cap
- [Trusted Accounts](https://docs.intuition.systems/docs/v1/tutorials/queries/discovering-most-trusted-accounts.md): Find and rank ecosystem participants by stake
